#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <unordered_map>

using namespace std;

struct IntList {
    vector<int> data;
    int size;

    IntList() : data(3), size(0) {}

    bool isEmpty() const {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int get(int index) const {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        return data[index];
    }

    void clear() {
        size = 0;
    }

    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void expand() {
        if (size >= (int)data.size()) {
            data.resize((data.size() << 1) + 1);
        }
    }

    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        expand();
        data.insert(data.begin() + index, value);
        size++;
    }

    int deleteAt(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        int val = data[index];
        data.erase(data.begin() + index);
        size--;
        return val;
    }

    void push(int value) {
        expand();
        if (size >= (int)data.size()) data.resize(data.size() + 1);
        data[size++] = value;
    }

    int pop() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No element");
        return data[--size];
    }

    void unshift(int value) {
        expand();
        data.insert(data.begin(), value);
        size++;
    }

    int shift() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No element");
        int val = data[0];
        data.erase(data.begin());
        size--;
        return val;
    }
};

struct IntIntMap {
    static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;
    vector<int> data;
    int size;

    IntIntMap() : data(4, EMPTY), size(0) {}

    bool isEmpty() const {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int getSize() const {
        return size;
    }

    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)data.size(); i += 2) {
            data[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        size = 0;
    }

    static int hash(int key) {
        int hashVal = key * 1000000007;
        hashVal ^= (hashVal >> 16);
        hashVal ^= (hashVal >> 24);
        return hashVal;
    }

    bool have(int key) const {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        int mask = (int)data.size() - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) return true;
            else if (cur == EMPTY) return false;
        }
    }

    int get(int key, int default_) const {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        int mask = (int)data.size() - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) return data[i + 1];
            else if (cur == EMPTY) return default_;
        }
    }

    static vector<int> resize(const vector<int>& oldData, int newCapacity) {
        vector<int> newData(newCapacity, EMPTY);
        int mask = newCapacity - 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)oldData.size(); i += 2) {
            int cur = oldData[i];
            if (cur == EMPTY) continue;
            for (int j = hash(cur) & mask;; j = (j - 1) & mask) {
                if (newData[j] == EMPTY) {
                    newData[j] = cur;
                    newData[j + 1] = oldData[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return newData;
    }

    void set(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        int capacity = (int)data.size();
        int mask = capacity - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                data[i + 1] = value;
                return;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                data[i] = key;
                data[i + 1] = value;
                if (++size > capacity >> 2) {
                    data = resize(data, capacity << 1);
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void deleteKey(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        int capacity = (int)data.size();
        int mask = capacity - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                for (int j = i;;) {
                    int nextIdx = (j - 1) & mask;
                    int nextVal = data[nextIdx];
                    if (nextVal == EMPTY) {
                        data[j] = EMPTY;
                        --size;
                        return;
                    }
                    int k = hash(nextVal) & mask;
                    if (((k >= i) ? 1 : 0) ^ ((k >= nextIdx) ? 1 : 0) ^ ((i >= nextIdx) ? 1 : 0)) {
                        data[j] = nextVal;
                        data[j + 1] = data[nextIdx + 1];
                        j = nextIdx;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return;
            }
        }
    }
};

vector<IntList> freeLists;

IntList takeList() {
    if (freeLists.empty()) {
        return IntList();
    } else {
        IntList lst = freeLists.back();
        freeLists.pop_back();
        return lst;
    }
}

void putList(IntList& list) {
    list.clear();
    freeLists.push_back(list);
}

int n, m;

IntList solve(int from, int to) {
    IntList res;
    if (from + 1 == to) {
        res = takeList();
        res.push(from);
        if (from + m > n) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from - n);
        }
        res.push(m);
        if (from > m) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from);
        }
        res.push(-from);
    } else {
        int mid = (from + to) >> 1;
        IntList a = solve(from, mid);
        IntList b = solve(mid, to);
        res = takeList();
        int aSize = a.size;
        int bSize = b.size;
        int* aData = a.data.data();
        int* bData = b.data.data();
        for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = (i == 0) ? 0 : bData[i - 1];
            int bTo = (i == bSize - 1) ? n : bData[i + 1];
            int bShift = bData[i];
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo = bTo + bShift;
            int l = 0, r = aSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int mIdx = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (aData[mIdx] <= aFrom) {
                    l = mIdx + 1;
                } else {
                    r = mIdx - 1;
                }
            }
            int cur = l;
            while (true) {
                res.push(bShift + aData[cur]);
                ++cur;
                if (cur == aSize) break;
                int pos = aData[cur];
                if (pos >= aTo) break;
                res.push(pos - bShift);
                ++cur;
            }
            if (i == bSize - 1) break;
            res.push(bTo);
        }
        putList(a);
        putList(b);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int s;
    long long t;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cin >> s;
    cin >> t;
    s -= 1;
    long long t_mod = t % n;
    for (long long ct = t_mod; ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += 1;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= 1;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
    }
    long long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve.size;
        int* csData = cycleSolve.data.data();
        IntList cycleList = takeList();
        IntIntMap cycleMap;
        for (int it = 0;; it++) {
            if (it == cycles) break;
            int prev = cycleMap.get(s, -1);
            if (prev >= 0) {
                s = cycleList.get(prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (it - prev)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList.push(s);
            cycleMap.set(s, it);
            int l = 0, r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int mIdx = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (csData[mIdx] <= s) {
                    l = mIdx + 1;
                } else {
                    r = mIdx - 1;
                }
            }
            s += csData[l];
        }
        putList(cycleList);
    }
    cout << s + 1 << "\n";
    return 0;
}
